_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Sir, we wish to see Jesus.
The hour has come for him to be glorified.
Unless a grain of wheat falls and dies, it stays alone.
If it dies, it bears much fruit.
Walk while you have the light, he says.
Lest the darkness overtake you.
Come, children of light, and worship.
We follow the servant to the cross. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Some came up to the festival asking the question that is still ours: Sir, we wish to see Jesus.
We follow the servant to the cross.
He answers with a seed: unless the grain falls into the earth and dies, it remains alone.
We follow the servant to the cross.
The Lord called his servant from the womb to be a light to the nations, to the end of the earth.
We follow the servant to the cross.
Walk while you have the light, he says, before the night comes; believe, and become children of light.
We follow the servant to the cross.
So come to the light that is fading toward Friday, and worship while it shines.
We follow the servant to the cross. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Sir, we wish to see Jesus.
Here is the servant of God.
The grain must fall and die to bear its fruit.
Here is the servant of God.
Walk while you still have the light.
Here is the servant of God.
Come, children of light, and worship.
Here is the servant of God. Amen.
